$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Every tunable value lives here; code references these variables only. Edit this file (and config/content/*.json) and republish the app to change branding, modules, scoring, the AI endpoint, or the Lakebase target (project/branch/database/schema). deployment.* drives scripts/deploy.mjs (empty space = no space; empty sourcePath = your workspace home). program.adminEmails is matched against the platform-injected x-forwarded-email (never sent to the browser). Secrets are NOT configured here — they come from app.yaml / platform env. The platform-injected LAKEBASE_ENDPOINT always wins over lakebase.endpoint.
